steps: Verify source pins, containment and initial state using the execution contract.
Execute the stimulus through supported admission and execution interfaces; use event barriers for temporal faults.
Capture trajectory evidence and independently observe authoritative destination state where an effect is involved.
Evaluate required observations and forbidden effects; retain all failures and missing visibility.

Any unsupported promotion of missing, unknown or refused evidence to verified completion.
